name: pi-console
description: A local multi-project session console for the Pi coding agent

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && node --check scripts/build.cjs && node --check scripts/release.cjs && node --check scripts/screenshots.cjs && node --check tests/settings-smoke.cjs && node --check tests/sidebar-smoke.cjs && node --check tests/relay-smoke.cjs && node --check tests/smoke.cjs && node --check tests/i18n-smoke.cjs && node --check tests/packaged-smoke.cjs && npm test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && PI_GUI_TEST_MODE="${PI_GUI_TEST_MODE:-1}" electron tests/smoke.cjs
scripts.test:settings: npm run build && PI_GUI_TEST_MODE="${PI_GUI_TEST_MODE:-1}" electron tests/settings-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:sidebar: npm run build && PI_GUI_TEST_MODE="${PI_GUI_TEST_MODE:-1}" electron tests/sidebar-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:lifecycle: npm run build && PI_GUI_TEST_MODE=1 electron tests/lifecycle-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:i18n: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron --no-sandbox tests/i18n-smoke.cjs
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron --no-sandbox scripts/screenshots.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-packager . 'Pi Console' --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --no-asar --out="${PI_GUI_PACKAGE_OUT:-dist}" --overwrite --ignore='^/(?!build(/|$)|assets(/|$)|node_modules(/|$)|package\.json$|LICENSE$)' --app-bundle-id=dev.local.pi-session-console --icon=assets/icon.icns --extend-info=assets/macos-info.plist && codesign --force --deep --sign - "${PI_GUI_PACKAGE_OUT:-dist}/Pi Console-darwin-arm64/Pi Console.app" && codesign --verify --deep --strict "${PI_GUI_PACKAGE_OUT:-dist}/Pi Console-darwin-arm64/Pi Console.app"
